declared.core.strategic.gru: --no-strategic: the strategic context is computed only as a diagnostic (out['ctx']); no training loss reads it
declared.core.strategic.proj: --no-strategic: the strategic context projection, bypassed with the layer
declared.core.decoder.offset_head: sampler build: `_sample` REPLACES the classifier-pass fan `bank + offset`; out['offset'] is read by no training loss
declared.core.decoder.ctx_to_cond: --no-strategic (S-BYPASS-1): the decoder receives ctx=None, so ctx_to_cond never runs
declared.core.decoder.lat_to_anchor: --graft-tac8-prior (refcv6 sec. 4): the tactical 8x8 posterior REPLACES the image-only lat3 prior; the call site passes lat_prior=None
declared.core.decoder.lon_to_anchor: --graft-tac8-prior (refcv6 sec. 4): the tactical 8x8 posterior REPLACES the image-only lon3 prior; the call site passes lon_prior=None
declared.core.decoder.control_head: F3: `_decode_ctrl` emits the CASCADE's last stage (DD's per-layer heads); control_head(q) runs only when self.cascade is None
declared.core.route_head: --no-strategic: the route readout; route_loss_applied is False and the route graft is off
declared.str_goal_head: --no-strategic: the strategic goal head; its hindsight loss is dropped with the layer (goal_str_loss_applied False)
declared.gstr_embed: --no-strategic (S-BYPASS-2): the strategic goal's FiLM on the tactical latent is skipped
declared.gstr_film: --no-strategic (S-BYPASS-2): the strategic goal's FiLM on the tactical latent is skipped
declared.nav_to_str: --no-strategic: nav -> strategic ctx feeds only the diagnostic ctx; nav still reaches tactical (nav_to_tac) and operative (meas_in)
declared.scorer.goal_point: E9 always passes goal_point=g2 (the structured goal); the free decode is returned only as out['goal_point_free'] and read by no training loss
